name: OpEnUV Simulator
description: Physics-accurate EUV lithography simulator for semiconductor process modeling. Implements full optical stack: LPP Sn-plasma source, CXRO materials, multilayer TMM optics, RCWA mask3D, Abbe/Hopkins aerial imaging with partial coherence, resist chain (Dill ABC, PEB, development, shot noise), process window analysis, and resist calibration from wafer data. Open source (Apache-2.0), 534 tests passing, 6 verified Jupyter notebooks, CI/CD across 48 wheel configurations.

skills.name: euv-simulation
skills.description: Run full EUV lithography simulations with configurable source, optics, mask, aerial imaging, and resist models. Supports conventional, annular, quadrupole, and dipole illumination.

skills.name: process-window
skills.description: Generate Bossung curves, CD heatmaps, NILS maps, Depth of Focus (DoF), and Exposure Latitude (EL) across focus-dose space. Exports PNG plots and CSV data.

skills.name: calibration
skills.description: Fit resist parameters (Dill C/Q, PEB kinetics, Mack development) from experimental wafer CD measurements using scipy optimization with bootstrap confidence intervals.

skills.name: physics-validation
skills.description: Validate simulation against analytical references and published SPIE/JM3 data. Gates: NILS error < 0.3, CD error < 5%, LER/LWR extraction in physical units.
